lines.text: Bento Term shows all of your agents on one screen.
Each pane is tinted by what it’s doing. Blue means working. Amber means it’s waiting for you. Green means it finished.
You answer the one that needs you. The rest keep running.
You can talk to a pane instead of typing. Hold right click, and speak.
Speaking is about three times faster than typing. Bento reads the screen, so file names and technical words come out right.
Everything runs in tmux on your machine, not inside the app. You can quit the app,
The phone app connects to the same session. Same panes, still running.
You can answer from wherever you are.
Bento Term is free and open source, for Mac, iPhone and iPad.
